title: Asking about a plan
alt: A child gestures while a seated adult listens beside a chart of blank ruled lines.
scene: One child stands beside an adult seated at child height. Child gestures with an open hand mid-question; adult leans in to listen. Both look at a paper chart on wall with blank ruled lines only. Calm welcoming faces.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Wide lesson composition with generous clean margins. One child stands beside an adult seated at child height. Child gestures with an open hand mid-question; adult leans in to listen. Both look at a paper chart on wall with blank ruled lines only. Calm welcoming faces. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols.
